dataset: Robot Execution Failures, LP1: approach to grasp position

rights.basis: Original UCI dataset license; both original creators and the Kaggle mirror are credited.
rights.licenseDifference: The mirror lists CC0. This study retains original UCI attribution and does not assert that the mirror can remove the original terms.
rights.changes: Only LP1 text data is retained. Kaggle CSV bytes and UCI data bytes are unchanged. Labels are joined only after exact numeric trace alignment.

sampling.units: Source measurement units are not specified; no SI-unit conversion is claimed.
sampling.timing: Collected after failure detection, not a pre-action forecast.

protocol.scope: LP1 only: offline diagnosis retrieval, not recovery or pre-failure prediction
protocol.split: Within each original label, sort episodes by SHA256 of canonical integer samples; first ceil(classCount/5) are queries. Remaining episodes are reference memory. No window-level split.
protocol.features: All 90 raw values; channel scale is population standard deviation across reference-memory samples only. Zero scale becomes 1. No tuning.
protocol.retrieval: One nearest reference episode by squared Euclidean distance after channel scaling. Equal distance ties resolve by source episode index.
protocol.baseline: Majority label in reference memory; equal counts resolve lexicographically.
limits: No physical control or new payments
No recovery outcome or controller execution data
Robot model, gripper and production context are not established
Only LP1; other subsets have duplicate traces
No downloaded code or executable artifacts are used
